name: Villainous Nights
source:
San Francisco living just got a whole lot better thanks to your new internship at Optimus, the leading sponsor of super powered humans in the world! But when you catch an intruder in the act of villainous deeds, your perspective gets seriously altered. Even evil is just shades of grey, and love can bloom in the darkest of nights.

[From [url=https://lovestruckvoltage.tumblr.com/post/171315570158/pilot-series-villainous-nights-out-now-san]Voltage Lovestruck blog[/url]]
translation:
感谢你在Optimus的新实习，旧金山的生活变得更好了，Optimus是世界上超能力人类的主要赞助商！但当你抓到一个正在做坏事的入侵者时，你的观点就会发生严重改变。即使邪恶也只是灰色的阴影，而爱可以在最黑暗的夜晚绽放。

[来自[url=https://lovestruckvoltage.tumblr.com/post/171315570158/pilot-series-villainous-nights-out-now-san]Voltage Lovestruck博客[/url]]
